aprs.title: APRS
aprs.summary: Native software Bell 202 RX, packet browser and incoming message/position viewer. No optional firmware feature set.

aprs-gps-sync.title: GPS Sync
aprs-gps-sync.summary: Adopt a direct APRS position from AG7SU-7 into native radio settings. Requires API 23; hardware reception and save callback verified.

aprs-beacon.title: APRS Beacon
aprs-beacon.summary: Manually confirmed AX.25 position beacon using the radio settings. RF transmit awaiting physical validation.

aprs-kiss-rx.title: APRS KISS RX
aprs-kiss-rx.summary: Receive-only AX.25 KISS serial bridge. Physical UART validation pending.

cardlink.title: Card Link
cardlink.summary: Experimental over-air PixelQSO card transfers. Requires the optional Data feature set.

explore_scan.title: Explore Scan
explore_scan.summary: Repeater scanning and candidate ranking. Requires the Scan feature set.
